thread:
zoe: Noticing a new pattern in us-west2 after NAT gateway swap: GPUs show free in `nvidia-smi` but scheduler refuses to place pods - slot appears reserved.

carlos: Saw that too. Node-agent logs show a brief reconnect then `kvcache: lease uid mismatch` and hold_count stays >0. Pods Pending with 'no matching free gpu-slot'.

sre-oncall: Quick manual fix that unblocks us: `kubectl annotate node N gpu-slot-gc=true` then run `curl -sS http://$NODE_IP:5000/internal/reclaim?force=true` on the node. Restarts also clear it.

zoe: Looks correlated with NAT IP rotation timing. Conn reset during rotation leaves stale KV refs. We'll need an agent-side GC that detects missing kubelet heartbeats and reclaims after Xs.

scheduler-bot: Note: gang admission holds reservations until all members report. If one slot is ghosted the whole gang is blocked. Metric request: `scheduler.allocated_slots_without_pod` + `kvcache.stuck_slots`.

carlos: Proposed short term: canary in us-west2b that lowers reclaim threshold from 30s->12s and adds a NAT-signal hook so nodes GC proactively. I'll schedule 01:00-02:00 UTC window and add Datadog alert `gpu.slot_leaks>5`.

sre-oncall: Keep TTL conservative for now; shorter TTL increases cold starts by ~10%. Add runbook steps and open INFRA-4382 for rollout and rollback plans.
